patch_source: Official GAFL install_gatr.sh, both official patches applied cleanly with git apply; no network layer substitution
backflip1_units: Released global_rmsf head predicts Angstrom directly. Its label generation uses Angstrom atom coordinates and no nm scaling; only internal geometric features are divided by 10. No output conversion applied.
backflip2_units: Released per_res_covariance is nm^2; output converted as 10*sqrt(trace(C)) Angstrom.

opt_einsum.source: Exact source required by official GATr setup.py
opt_einsum.compatibility_change: Only empty-shape test changed from operand_shapes[num] == () to len(operand_shapes[num]) == 0. NumPy 1.26 raises on the former array/empty-tuple comparison; older NumPy returned false for nonempty shape. Contraction equations, optimization, order and network computations unchanged.
